description: Full email deliverability audit of a domain (bare domain, e.g. example.com). Resolves the domain's mail DNS over DNS-over-HTTPS and runs 12 weighted checks: MX presence and redundancy, SPF presence, validity (single record, <=10 DNS lookups), and terminal policy (-all vs ~all vs ?all), DMARC presence, enforcement policy (p=reject/quarantine/none, pct), and aggregate reporting (rua), DKIM discoverability at 10 common selectors, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, and BIMI. These records decide whether receivers can verify mail claiming to be from the domain: no DMARC (or p=none) means the domain is trivially spoofable by anyone, and broken SPF/DKIM alignment is why legitimate mail lands in spam. Returns machine-readable JSON: 0-100 score, A-F grade, a spoofing/deliverability risk level (Low/Moderate/Elevated/High) with the failing spoofing-class checks named, per-check pass/partial/fail/unknown with evidence, the observed records (MX hosts, SPF record, DMARC policy/pct, DKIM selectors found, MTA-STS/TLS-RPT/BIMI presence), and the top 3 prioritized fixes. HONEST LIMITS: this is a DNS snapshot at scan time; DKIM is probed at common selectors only (a custom selector reads as undiscoverable, not absent); no mail is sent, and inbox placement is not guaranteed. Cost: $1.50 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402 — the caller's agent pays from its owner's approved wallet; no API key needed. Use this before launching outbound from a domain, after any DNS change, or to triage a spoofing/spam-folder problem.
